title: The NSE acknowledges that sustainable development requires continuous
columns:
GOAL 5: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls. We
remains committed to promoting gender equality and empowering women
in the capital market and beyond. We recognize that gender equality is not
only a fundamental human right but also a driver of social and economic
progress. Through various initiatives and partnerships, we strive to create a
more inclusive and equitable environment for women
